This '''unidentified male''' [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]] was the first [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] of a [[Gender/Legends|woman]] named [[Droo Rawk|Droo of clan Vos]] and a member of the [[Kiffu Guardians]]. Some time after he [[Death/Legends|died]] in the service, Droo married a man named [[Rawk|Nat Skywalker]].
